headline: US Lawmakers Propose Banning DUV Chipmaking Tool Exports to Leading Chinese Firms, Escalating Tech Trade War.
summary: Bipartisan legislation targeting DUV lithography equipment represents a significant escalation in US export controls, directly impacting China's semiconductor fabrication capabilities and hindering its development of AI infrastructure. This regulatory shift will further fragment global tech supply chains and create considerable market uncertainty for equipment manufacturers like ASML and Chinese firms like Huawei and SMIC.
